items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Reig always called me 'Magsie.' He always called me that.

ctx.x: Teddy Reig always called me "Magsie." He always called me that. So he just said, "I'll put that on the album." I said, "That's all right with me. If you want to use that name, it's all right" -- because soon they'll find out....
Everybody knew who it was anyway.
